title: feat(spec): App as the consumer-facing unit (ADR-0019)
body:
## What

Makes the **App the one consumer-facing unit**: the thing a tenant downloads, opens, and uninstalls is exactly one App. Removes the confusing "package / suite contains N apps" model from the consumer surface.

> **Scope note:** This PR was deliberately **narrowed**. Earlier revisions explored a larger scheme (a metadata/code runtime-plane split, a "consumer App must be pure metadata" mandate, a capability-by-reference contract, auto-reviewed trust lanes). That was **reverted** — its premises did not hold (consumer apps legitimately carry code-bearing metadata such as L2 sandboxed-JS hooks; auto-review was dropped as a requirement). The larger ideas are recorded in ADR-0019 §"Out of scope" as a separate, gated bet. **This PR ships only the cheap, certain, high-value part: the consumer surface.**

## Changes (all additive / non-breaking)

- **`isConsumerInstallable(type)` + `CONSUMER_INSTALLABLE_TYPES`** (`plugin.zod.ts`) — the single source of truth for "what a consumer can install" (today: only `type: app`). The `type` enum is unchanged; this is a semantic split layered on top.
- **`MarketplaceListingSchema.packageType`** constrained to `CONSUMER_INSTALLABLE_TYPES` (default `app`) — a non-App (driver/server/plugin/…) consumer listing **cannot be represented**, so "consumers see only Apps" is enforced in the data contract, not a forgettable query filter.
- **`defineStack` enforces at most one App per package** — a `type: app` package may not define >1 app (the banned "suite contains apps" shape throws with a clear fix: fold into one app with multiple tabs, or split into separate packages). Zero apps is allowed; non-`app` types are unconstrained.
- **Docs** — ADR-0019 (decision = D1–D4), plus `package-registry.zod.ts` header and `marketplace-publishing.md` (§1/§2/§6) realigned to the App model.
- Tests for all three behaviours; changeset included.

No runtime / registry / execution changes.

## Decision (ADR-0019)

- **D1** — the App is the only consumer-facing unit (download = open = uninstall).
- **D2** — only `type: app` is consumer-installable / Marketplace-listed; everything else is an invisible internal contribution ("frameworks inside the .app bundle").
- **D3** — no "suite contains apps" aggregator; suites fold into one App, or ship as independent Apps (the iWork split).
- **D4** — an App owns a *set* of namespaces; uninstall is atomic over that set.

## Verification

- `packages/spec` full suite green locally (6628 passing); `tsc --noEmit` clean.

## Follow-ups (outside this repo, consume the same predicate)

- Console `marketplace` UI / cloud catalog populate `packageType` from the manifest and filter to `type: app`.
- Fold HotCRM into a single App (`objectstack-ai/hotcrm`).

## Known CI note

The `Test Core` red is a **pre-existing failure on `main`, unrelated to this PR**: `packages/objectql/src/metadata-validation-sweep.test.ts` uses an outdated `workflow` fixture (missing `id`/`initial`/`states` after the workflow→state-machine migration). Verified by running the test on a clean `origin/main` worktree; this branch does not touch `objectql`.
